versions.changelog:
Initial release of complete LinkdAPI OpenClaw integration.

- Full support for 50+ LinkedIn data endpoints: profiles, people searches, companies, posts, jobs, articles, comments, services, and more
- Includes Python, Node.js, and Go SDK references
- Detailed authentication notes—requires only X-linkdapi-apikey header (not x-api-key or Bearer)
- Handy quick reference for all endpoints, common parameters, and core LinkedIn data concepts
- Example workflows included for lead enrichment, company research, ICP search, and market intelligence
- Designed to handle any LinkedIn data lookup or API workflow
